name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
description: A large centred word that dissolves through a heavy blur and re-forms as the next phrase in a list, cycling forever without the layout moving.
use: A hero needs a short list of phrases to cycle in place without shifting the layout.
avoid: Long phrases or many messages; big blurred text is hard to follow on a loop.
a11y: The rotating words sit in plain spans with no live region, and the endless loop ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single very large, heavy white sans-serif word sits in the middle of an otherwise empty black canvas. During a transition the word softens into a fat, rounded blob before sharpening into the next word.
behaves: The current word blurs out while the incoming word sharpens in, the two briefly melting together, then the new word holds for half a second before the cycle repeats down the list.
customise: The phrases are passed as a texts array and size, height and spacing come from the class name; the blur filter and the 1.5s morph and 0.5s hold are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop runs nonstop, blurring and fading two text spans every frame.
